summary: The test suite now exercises llama.cpp inference through both the existing and hardware-inference paths, including runs in separate processes, and checks how text generation behaves when requests overlap or are cancelled. It also adds end-to-end performance tests and shared metrics for ML engines, while improving test reliability and cleanup for ONNX and other model backends. Together, these changes make it easier to catch problems in real-world inference, measure performance, and track where the work happens.
